blocks.text: O'zbek tilida «ko'p» hamma narsa bilan ishlatiladi: **ko'p** pul, **ko'p** kitob, **ko'p** vaqt. Ingliz tilida esa ot sanaladimi yoki yo'qmi (67–68-darslar) — shunga qarab so'z tanlanadi: sanaladigan otning ko'pligi bilan — **many** (many books), sanalmaydigan ot bilan — **much** (much money). **a lot of** esa ikkalasi bilan ham ishlatiladi va eng xavfsiz tanlov.

rows: **a lot of** books, **a lot of** money

blocks.text: Savolda bu farq o'zbekchaga ham o'xshaydi: «**Nechta**?» — sanaladigan narsa haqida → **How many** + ko'plik (How many brothers?). «**Qancha**?» — miqdor haqida → **How much** + sanalmaydigan ot (How much water?). Narx so'raganda ham — **How much** is it? (Qancha turadi?).

items.text: How **many** rooms are there in your flat?
How **much** flour do I need for the bread?
How **much** are the tickets to Bukhara?

blocks.text: **much** va **many** asosan **savol** va **inkor** gaplarda ishlatiladi. Darak gapda **much** juda g'alati eshitiladi: «We have much time» emas — We have **a lot of** time. **many** darak gapda xato emas (Many people think ...), lekin rasmiyroq; so'zlashuvda **a lot of** / **lots of** ko'proq. **a lot of** da **of** tushib qolmaydi: «a lot books» emas.

items.text: My uncle has **a lot of** sheep in his village.
There's **a lot of** dust on these shelves.

blocks.text: Inkorda **not much** / **not many** — «ko'p emas», «unchalik ko'p emas»: I don't have **much** time. Savolda — «ko'pmi?»: Are there **many** tourists? Bu gaplarda **a lot of** ham to'g'ri, lekin **much / many** juda tabiiy eshitiladi.

items.text: Is there **much** noise from the street at night?

blocks.text: Fe'ldan keyin, otsiz — «ko'p», «juda»: darakda **a lot** (She reads **a lot**. I like it **a lot**.), inkor va savolda **much** ham bo'ladi (He doesn't eat **much**. Do you travel **much**?). O'zbekcha «ko'p ishlaydi» — works **a lot** («works much» emas). «I like it much» deyilmaydi — **a lot** yoki **very much**. Ot oldin aytilgan bo'lsa: I've got **a lot** / I haven't got **many**.

items.text: Grandpa sleeps **a lot** in the afternoon.
I don't use my car **much** — I usually walk.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «many money» → **much money** / **a lot of money**; «much books» → **many books**; «How many money?» → **How much money?**; «I have much work.» → **I have a lot of work.**; «a lot books» → **a lot of books**; «He works much.» → **He works a lot.**; «I like it much.» → **I like it a lot / very much.**
Eslab qolish: «**Nechta**?» — **many** (sanaladi), «**Qancha**?» — **much** (sanalmaydi). Ikkilansangiz, darak gapda **a lot of** ni ishlating — u har doim to'g'ri.
Bog'liq darslar: «oz, biroz» — **(a) little / (a) few** → 84-dars; **too much / too many** → 92-dars; **enough** → 91-dars; qiyosiy daraja oldida **much** (much bigger) → 88-dars.

examples.title: **many** + plural nouns
examples.description: **many** — sanaladigan otning ko'pligi bilan: **many** friends, **many** times. Ko'pincha savol va inkorda. «Nechta?» — **How many**?

sentences.text: Are there **many** tourists in Bukhara in summer?
sentences.translation: Yozda Buxoroda sayyohlar **ko'p** bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: Aziz doesn't have **many** friends in his new school.
sentences.translation: Azizning yangi maktabida do'stlari **ko'p emas**.

sentences.text: How **many** languages do you speak?
sentences.translation: **Nechta** tilda gaplashasiz?

sentences.text: **Many** people in Tashkent speak both Uzbek and Russian.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda **ko'p** odamlar o'zbekcha ham, ruscha ham gapiradi.

sentences.text: We didn't take **many** photos because it was raining.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir yog'ayotgani uchun **unchalik ko'p** surat olmadik.

sentences.text: Madina has read **many** books about Amir Timur.
sentences.translation: Madina Amir Temur haqida **ko'plab** kitob o'qigan.

sentences.text: Were there **many** people at the concert?
sentences.translation: Konsertda odam **ko'p** edimi?

sentences.text: There aren't **many** good restaurants near the station.
sentences.translation: Vokzal yaqinida yaxshi restoranlar **ko'p emas**.

sentences.text: I've visited London **many** times, but I've never been to Scotland.
sentences.translation: Londonda **ko'p** marta bo'lganman, lekin Shotlandiyada hech qachon bo'lmaganman.

sentences.text: How **many** eggs do we need for this cake?
sentences.translation: Bu tort uchun **nechta** tuxum kerak?

examples.title: **much** + uncountable nouns
examples.description: **much** — sanalmaydigan ot bilan: **much** money, **much** time, **much** snow. Asosan savol va inkorda. «Qancha?» — **How much**?

sentences.text: How **much** money have you got?
sentences.translation: **Qancha** pulingiz bor?

sentences.text: I don't have **much** time today — can we talk tomorrow?
sentences.translation: Bugun vaqtim **ko'p emas** — ertaga gaplashsak bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: There isn't **much** milk left. Can you buy some?
sentences.translation: Sut **ko'p** qolmagan. Sotib ola olasizmi?

sentences.text: How **much** is this bag?
sentences.translation: Bu sumka **qancha** turadi?

sentences.text: Did you have **much** snow in Samarkand last winter?
sentences.translation: O'tgan qish Samarqandda qor **ko'p** yog'dimi?

sentences.text: Tom doesn't eat **much** meat — he prefers fish.
sentences.translation: Tom go'shtni **ko'p** yemaydi — baliqni afzal ko'radi.

sentences.text: Is there **much** traffic in the city centre in the morning?
sentences.translation: Ertalab shahar markazida tirbandlik **ko'p** bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: We didn't get **much** information from the receptionist.
sentences.translation: Qabulxona xodimidan **ko'p** ma'lumot ololmadik.

sentences.text: Do you put **much** sugar in your tea?
sentences.translation: Choyingizga **ko'p** shakar solasizmi?

sentences.text: Sarah hasn't done **much** work this week because she's been ill.
sentences.translation: Sara bu hafta **ko'p** ish qilmadi, chunki kasal edi.

examples.title: Positive sentences: **a lot of** / **lots of**
examples.description: Darak gapda eng tabiiy shakl — **a lot of** (so'zlashuvda **lots of**): sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlar bilan. «We have much time» o'rniga — We have **a lot of** time.

sentences.text: We've got **a lot of** time before the train leaves.
sentences.translation: Poyezd jo'nashigacha vaqtimiz **ko'p**.

sentences.text: There are **a lot of** parks in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda bog'lar **ko'p**.

sentences.text: Bekzod drinks **a lot of** coffee when he's working.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ishlayotganda **ko'p** qahva ichadi.

sentences.text: Emma has **lots of** friends in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Emmaning Manchesterda do'stlari **juda ko'p**.

sentences.text: **A lot of** people came to the wedding — over three hundred!
sentences.translation: To'yga **juda ko'p** odam keldi — uch yuzdan ortiq!

sentences.text: My grandmother puts **a lot of** garlic in her soup.
sentences.translation: Buvim sho'rvasiga **ko'p** sarimsoq soladi.

sentences.text: It's a popular hotel, so it gets **lots of** visitors in summer.
sentences.translation: Bu mashhur mehmonxona, shuning uchun yozda mehmonlar **ko'p** bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Madina spends **a lot of** money on clothes.
sentences.translation: Madina kiyimga **ko'p** pul sarflaydi.

sentences.text: We had **a lot of** rain last month, and the river was very high.
sentences.translation: O'tgan oy yomg'ir **ko'p** yog'di, daryo to'lib oqdi.

sentences.text: You've made **a lot of** progress in English this year!
sentences.translation: Bu yil ingliz tilida **ancha** yutuqqa erishdingiz!

examples.title: **a lot of** ↔ **not much** / **not many**
examples.description: Tasdiqda — **a lot of**, inkorda — **not much** (sanalmaydigan) yoki **not many** (sanaladigan). O'zbekchada: «ko'p» ↔ «ko'p emas».

sentences.text: Aziz has **a lot of** cousins, but I haven't got **many**.
sentences.translation: Azizning amakivachchalari **ko'p**, meniki esa **ko'p emas**.

sentences.text: There's **a lot of** traffic in the morning, but there isn't **much** at night.
sentences.translation: Ertalab tirbandlik **ko'p**, kechasi esa **unchalik ko'p emas**.

sentences.text: I eat **a lot of** fruit, but I don't eat **many** sweets.
sentences.translation: Men meva **ko'p** yeyman, lekin shirinlik **ko'p yemayman**.

sentences.text: London has **a lot of** museums, but our town doesn't have **many**.
sentences.translation: Londonda muzeylar **ko'p**, bizning shaharchada esa **ko'p emas**.

sentences.text: We had **lots of** fun at the party, but we didn't get **much** sleep.
sentences.translation: Ziyofatda **rosa** maza qildik, lekin **ko'p** uxlay olmadik.

sentences.text: Dilnoza reads **a lot of** books, but she doesn't watch **much** TV.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza kitobni **ko'p** o'qiydi, lekin televizorni **ko'p ko'rmaydi**.

sentences.text: The shop has **a lot of** shoes, but not **many** in my size.
sentences.translation: Do'konda poyabzal **ko'p**, lekin mening o'lchamimdagisi **ko'p emas**.

sentences.text: In summer there are **lots of** tourists, but in winter there aren't **many**.
sentences.translation: Yozda sayyohlar **juda ko'p**, qishda esa **ko'p emas**.

sentences.text: James earns **a lot of** money, but he doesn't have **much** free time.
sentences.translation: Jeyms **ko'p** pul ishlaydi, lekin bo'sh vaqti **ko'p emas**.

sentences.text: This dish needs **a lot of** onions but not **much** salt.
sentences.translation: Bu taomga **ko'p** piyoz kerak, lekin tuz **ko'p** kerak **emas**.

examples.title: **How many** ...? **How much** ...? — and answers
examples.description: «Nechta?» — **How many** + ko'plik; «Qancha?» — **How much** + sanalmaydigan (va narx). Javobda ham much / many / a lot.

sentences.text: How **many** children have you got? — Two, a boy and a girl.
sentences.translation: **Nechta** farzandingiz bor? — Ikkita, bir o'g'il, bir qiz.

sentences.text: How **much** water do you drink a day? — About two litres.
sentences.translation: Kuniga **qancha** suv ichasiz? — Taxminan ikki litr.

sentences.text: Excuse me, how **much** are these apples? — Ten thousand a kilo.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu olmalar **qancha** turadi? — Kilosi o'n ming.

sentences.text: Do you have **many** lessons on Monday? — Yes, six!
sentences.translation: Dushanba kuni darslaringiz **ko'p**mi? — Ha, oltita!

sentences.text: Was there **much** food left after the party? — No, not **much**.
sentences.translation: Ziyofatdan keyin ovqat **ko'p** qoldimi? — Yo'q, **ko'p emas**.

sentences.text: Madina, how **many** pages have you written? — Only three so far.
sentences.translation: Madina, **necha** bet yozdingiz? — Hozircha atigi uchta.

sentences.text: Did Tom spend **much** money in London? — Yes, **a lot**!
sentences.translation: Tom Londonda **ko'p** pul sarfladimi? — Ha, **juda ko'p**!

sentences.text: How **many** times a week do you go swimming? — Twice.
sentences.translation: Haftasiga **necha** marta suzishga borasiz? — Ikki marta.

sentences.text: Are there **many** good cafés in Oxford? — Yes, there are **lots**.
sentences.translation: Oksfordda yaxshi kafelar **ko'p**mi? — Ha, **juda ko'p**.

sentences.text: Have you got **much** homework tonight? — Not **much** — just one exercise.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun uy vazifangiz **ko'p**mi? — **Ko'p emas** — faqat bitta mashq.

examples.title: Without a noun: talk **a lot**, not go out **much**
examples.description: Fe'ldan keyin, otsiz: darakda — **a lot** (She travels **a lot**), inkor va savolda — **much** ham (I don't go out **much**). «I like it much» deyilmaydi — **a lot** yoki **very much**.

sentences.text: Sarah travels **a lot** for her job.
sentences.translation: Sara ishi tufayli **ko'p** sayohat qiladi.

sentences.text: I don't go out **much** during the week.
sentences.translation: Hafta ichida **unchalik** ko'chaga chiqmayman.

sentences.text: Thanks **a lot** for your help!
sentences.translation: Yordamingiz uchun **katta** rahmat!

sentences.text: My little brother talks **a lot**, but my sister is very quiet.
sentences.translation: Ukam **ko'p** gapiradi, singlim esa juda kamgap.

sentences.text: Do you watch TV **much**? — Not really, only the news.
sentences.translation: Televizorni **ko'p** ko'rasizmi? — Unchalik emas, faqat yangiliklarni.

sentences.text: Bekzod likes Manchester **a lot** — he wants to stay there.
sentences.translation: Bekzodga Manchester **juda** yoqadi — u yerda qolmoqchi.

sentences.text: It doesn't rain **much** in Bukhara in summer.
sentences.translation: Yozda Buxoroda yomg'ir **ko'p** yog'maydi.

sentences.text: We enjoyed the trip **very much**.
sentences.translation: Sayohat bizga **juda** yoqdi.

sentences.text: Aziz has changed **a lot** since he started university.
sentences.translation: Aziz universitetga kirganidan beri **ancha** o'zgardi.

sentences.text: Did you sleep **much** last night? You look tired.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechasi **ko'p** uxladingizmi? Charchagan ko'rinyapsiz.

examples.title: Planning a party: How **many** people are coming?
examples.description: Ziyofatga tayyorgarlik suhbati: **How many** / **How much**, inkorda **not many / not much**, darakda **a lot of / lots of**.

sentences.text: — How **many** people are coming to Dilnoza's birthday?
sentences.translation: — Dilnozaning tug'ilgan kuniga **necha** kishi keladi?

sentences.text: — Not **many** — about fifteen.
sentences.translation: — **Ko'p emas** — o'n beshtacha.

sentences.text: — OK. How **much** food do we need, then?
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi. Unda **qancha** ovqat kerak?

sentences.text: — Quite **a lot**. Her friends love plov.
sentences.translation: — Ancha **ko'p**. Uning do'stlari palovni yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: — Have we got **much** rice at home?
sentences.translation: — Uyda guruch **ko'p**mi?

sentences.text: — Not **much**, only a kilo. We need to buy **a lot** more.
sentences.translation: — **Ko'p emas**, atigi bir kilo. Yana **ancha** sotib olishimiz kerak.

sentences.text: — And how **many** bottles of juice?
sentences.translation: — Sharbatdan-chi, **nechta** shisha?

sentences.text: — Let's buy ten. Children drink **lots of** juice.
sentences.translation: — O'nta olaylik. Bolalar sharbatni **ko'p** ichadi.

sentences.text: — Fine. We haven't got **much** money left this month, though.
sentences.translation: — Mayli. Lekin bu oy pulimiz **ko'p** qolmagan.

sentences.text: — Don't worry. **A lot of** her friends are bringing food too.
sentences.translation: — Xavotir olma. Do'stlarining **ko'pi** ham ovqat olib kelyapti.

examples.title: Mixed practice: **a lot of**, **much** or **many**?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: darakda **a lot of / lots of**, inkor va savolda **much / many**, otsiz **a lot** va **much**.

sentences.text: Is your group big? How **many** students are there?
sentences.translation: Guruhingiz kattami? **Nechta** talaba bor?

sentences.text: I haven't got **much** money, so I can't come to the cinema.
sentences.translation: Pulim **ko'p emas**, shuning uchun kinoga bora olmayman.

sentences.text: Samarkand has **a lot of** beautiful old buildings.
sentences.translation: Samarqandda go'zal qadimiy binolar **ko'p**.

sentences.text: There isn't **much** space in our kitchen.
sentences.translation: Oshxonamizda joy **ko'p emas**.

sentences.text: Did **many** people come to the meeting? — Not **many**, only six.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilishga **ko'p** odam keldimi? — **Ko'p emas**, atigi olti kishi.

sentences.text: James practises the piano **a lot** — every day.
sentences.translation: Jeyms pianinoda **ko'p** mashq qiladi — har kuni.

sentences.text: We don't have **many** chairs. Can you bring some?
sentences.translation: Stullarimiz **ko'p emas**. Bir nechtasini olib kela olasizmi?

sentences.text: How **much** does a ticket to London cost?
sentences.translation: Londonga chipta **qancha** turadi?

sentences.text: Madina has **lots of** ideas, but she doesn't have **much** time.
sentences.translation: Madinaning g'oyalari **juda ko'p**, lekin vaqti **ko'p emas**.

sentences.text: My father doesn't speak **much** English, but he understands **a lot**.
sentences.translation: Otam inglizchada **ko'p** gapira olmaydi, lekin **ko'p narsani** tushunadi.
